consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.preferencesIntro: Choose which cookies Everstead may use. Essential cookies keep you signed in and cannot be switched off. You can change your mind at any time from the Cookie settings link in the footer.
consent.moreBody: Full details, including how to delete cookies from your browser, are in our Cookie Policy.

sendToParents.title: Send this to your parents
sendToParents.body: Most parents mean to do this and never start. A message from you is the nudge that works.
sendToParents.message: Hi Mum, hi Dad. I have started using Everstead to keep our family's important details in one place: accounts, documents, who to call, what you would want. It is free to start and you can add one thing at a time. Would you set yours up too? {{link}}
sendToParents.subject: Something I set up for us
